name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted Open-Meteo weather forecast API that reads the public Open-Meteo dataset on demand and caches it locally.

alerts.message: The API has no authentication: anyone who knows the domain can query it. Weather data is licensed CC BY 4.0 and must be attributed to Open-Meteo.
On x86_64 the image is compiled for Skylake-class CPUs and needs AVX2: on an older or masked virtual CPU it exits at start with an illegal instruction error. arm64 servers are also supported.
